lead.headline: Lifshitz Phase of Quantum Gravity: The Infrared Fixed Point of the (2+1)D Unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons Model
body: We consider a nonrelativistic gravity theory in (2+1) dimensions with $w_\infty$ gauge symmetry that we call unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons gravity. The theory has three dimensionless couplings, one of which is the Chern-Simons level $κ$.

At large $|κ|$, the theory flows from an asymptotically free UV fixed point to an IR fixed point with anisotropic scale invariance characterized by a dynamical critical exponent $z=2-\tfrac32|κ|^{-1}$. We speculate that unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons gravity undergoes a phase transition from this scale-invariant phase to a confining phase when $κ$ drops below a critical value.
lead.authors: Maxim Zelenko and Dam Thanh Son
lead.deck: 5 pages; Mathematica notebooks included as ancillary files

features.headline: Exact lattice bosonization of the double-scaled $c=1$ matrix model
body: In a recent paper by two of us, it has been shown that entanglement entropy (EE) of matrix quantum mechanics (or, equivalently, of a non-relativistic fermion model) has a natural interpretation in terms of an exact bosonization of the fermion theory in terms of a lattice boson with lattice spacing $\sim 1/N$ (where $N$ is the rank of the matrix, equal to the number of fermions). The theory of this lattice boson is distinct from a latticized version of the "collective variable'' theory which is formulated in terms of the fermion density $ρ(λ)$ ("collective variable''); it is, in fact, more closely related to the Wigner distribution of the fermions.

features.headline: Holographic entropy inequalities & typical states
body: As a consequence of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula, static semiclassical states in AdS quantum gravity share a set of special properties expressible as linear inequalities on their entanglement entropies. How general are these properties?
Do they still hold when we move away from the regime of validity of RT, i.e. static states in classical Einstein gravity? Do they perhaps hold even for some class of non-holographic states?

features.headline: On memory effects in odd spacetime dimensions
body: We establish the existence of a new electromagnetic memory effect in all odd spacetime dimensions. This effect is a universal property of electromagnetic fields sourced by charged particles of constant momenta, appears at the Coulombic order and is directly related to the Weinberg soft theorem.
We provide a unified derivation of this effect in all higher dimensions by evaluating the Maxwell constraint on a null plane at large, finite distance.

stories.headline: Construction of holomorphic SCFTs with minimal index
body: It has been an open question whether there exist holomorphic VOAs with N=1 supersymmetry and Witten index 1 for any positive central charge c. The existence of such a theory with c=288 is closely related to the 576-periodicity of the TMF spectrum via the Segal-Stolz-Teichner conjecture.

stories.headline: Quantum Field Theory on the Tangent Bundle
body: We develop a quantum-field-theoretical framework on the tangent bundle in which gravitational and internal gauge structures are associated with different sectors of an affine tangent-fiber geometry. The translational sector supplies the coframe and its relation to teleparallel gravity.

stories.headline: Perturbative Holonomy Potentials and Vacua in Chiral Supersymmetric Gauge Theories
body: We establish global control of perturbative D-term data governing semiclassical vacuum sectors in chiral supersymmetric gauge theories on $\mathbb{R}^3\times S^1$. A closed-form, one-loop-exact D-term coefficient, including 4d Fayet--Iliopoulos (FI) parameters, gives a uniformly controlled leading potential away from massless thresholds and fixes local FI and Chern--Simons couplings near them.

stories.headline: Compositional Operational Rank, Smooth Realizability, and Dimensional Reduction
body: Higher-dimensional theories distinguish the dimensionality of a microscopic description from the number of directions accessible to a physical observer. Relating these notions requires not only dimensional reduction, but also a consistent preservation of operational independence across different levels of description.
stories.authors: Nikolay D. Tulupov and Alexander M. Tishin

stories.headline: Relating Dark Dimension Size with Dark Energy via 5D Quintessence Potential and Casimir Energy
body: We explore effective field theory (EFT) realizations of the dark dimension (DD) scenario in which the size of the DD is determined by the competition between a 5D quintessence potential and the Casimir energy. When only contributions from massless fields are considered, the Casimir energy does not have a typical energy scale, and the 4D dark energy (DE) scale is set by the height of the 5D quintessence potential.

stories.headline: Theory and Cosmology of Biverse Volume-Normalized Gravity
body: This dissertation expounds the biverse volume-normalized gravity, a novel theoretical framework of classical and quantum gravity that provides an unusual solution to the cosmological constant problem, the 60-degree-of-magnitude discrepancy between the value of the vacuum energy density in our universe predicted by particle physics and that implied by cosmological data.

stories.headline: Spin-Induced Coordinate Noncommutativity of the Covariant Centroid
body: The Tulczyjew-Dixon centroid of a massive spinning particle, built as a composite of canonical Poincaré variables, carries the exact coordinate algebra $\{X^μ,X^ν\}=-S^{μν}/p^2$, whose noncommutativity bivector is the transverse spin tensor of the particle itself rather than an external background.
stories.authors: Daniel Guimaraes Tedesco and Luiz Paulo Colatto

stories.headline: Revisiting monodromy defects in $\text{O}(N)$ conformal field theories
body: Monodromy defects are fundamental objects in extended quantum systems with global symmetries. We study such defects in $\text{O}(N)$ conformal field theories (CFT), which describe the universality class of $\text{O}(N)$ spontaneous symmetry breaking transitions.

sections.name: Across the Border
sections.note: Papers whose primary category is not hep-th (mostly gr-qc), cross-listed into it

stories.headline: From Specific Heat Bounds to Penrose-like Inequalities: A Unified Thermodynamic Perspective
body: Under explicit and physically motivated assumptions, we identify a local-to-global thermodynamic mechanism that organizes several previously disconnected inequalities on black holes. We first focus on asymptotically flat, static, and spherically-symmetric black holes, and provide a unified thermodynamic perspective on various Penrose-like inequalities.

stories.headline: Exact spinning wormholes in five dimensions from Toda integrability
body: We construct a new exact solution to the five-dimensional Einstein-phantom-scalar system that describes a rotating wormhole connecting two asymptotically flat regions. The solution represents a rotating generalization of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole with equal angular momenta.

stories.headline: Decoupled asymmetric thin-shell wormholes
body: We construct reflection-asymmetric thin-shell wormholes by joining a Schwarzschild exterior to its minimal geometric deformation, which shares the same mass and redshift function, so that the asymmetry is carried entirely by the gravitational-decoupling sector.

briefs.headline: Exact Stress Tensor Flows in Causal Electrodynamics: Courant-Hilbert Approach
briefs.text: It has been shown that for theories whose Courant-Hilbert function depends on a single dimensionful coupling, the energy-momentum tensor is controlled by the two combinations $τ\dot{\ell}$ and $\ell-τ\dot{\ell}$, so that the quadratic invariants $X=T_{μν}T^{μν}$ and $Y=(T^μ_μ)^2$ depend on a single auxiliary variable.

briefs.headline: Fixed Points of the Yang-Mills Gradient Flow in the Vortex Sector
briefs.text: We study the Yang-Mills gradient flow of center vortices in SU(2) gauge theory.

briefs.headline: Massive Scalar Quasinormal Modes and Quasibound States of Charged Black Holes with Logarithmic corrections
briefs.text: We study how long-range deformations in a black-hole metric affect the oscillation, trapping, and decay of a neutral, minimally coupled massive scalar field. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: The topological vertex is finitely generated
briefs.text: The topological vertex computes all genus amplitudes for the open topological A-model in $\mathbb{C}^3$ with branes on three toric Lagrangians and, via gluing, both open and closed string amplitudes on any toric Calabi-Yau threefold.

briefs.headline: The one-loop QCD scale anomaly on ADE orbifolds as an index
briefs.text: We derive the one-loop scale anomaly of $\SU(N)$ Yang--Mills on the orbifold $\R^4/Γ$, with $Γ\subset \SU(2)$ a finite subgroup, from an equivariant index theorem on twistor space.

briefs.headline: Exact Stress Tensor Flows in Causal Electrodynamics: Auxiliary Field Formalism
briefs.text: Causal self-dual nonlinear electrodynamics admits a simple auxiliary-field description: the Lagrangian is linear in the two Lorentz invariants of the field strength, and the dynamics is encoded in a potential $W(\varphi)$ of a single auxiliary variable.

briefs.headline: Graph-Based Algorithms for Worldline EFT Integrands
briefs.text: We present novel graph-centered algorithms for the construction and representation of worldline effective field theory (WEFT) integrands that separate the topological and algebraic structure of loop integrands into independent graph-numerator pairs.

briefs.headline: Reparametrisation invariance, anomalies and pseudoscalar states in massless quantum electrodynamics
briefs.text: In electrodynamics, and more generally in gauge theories, quantisation introduces an ambiguity whereby the vector current, the axial current, or both may acquire an anomalous divergence.

briefs.headline: Spiralling into Dark Energy: Axio-Dilaton Attractors in Light of Current Data
briefs.text: In string compactifications, dilaton-like moduli always come paired with axions, and the two fields interact through a curved field-space metric.

briefs.headline: The Free Scalar as a Thermal Envelope for Three-Dimensional CFTs
briefs.text: We conjecture that every unitary three-dimensional conformal field theory obeys $c_S/C_T\leq16πζ(3)$, where $s=c_ST^2$ is the thermal entropy density and $C_T$ the stress-tensor two-point coefficient, with equality for free scalars.
briefs.authors: Christopher P. Herzog and Andreas Stergiou

briefs.headline: Bargmann-invariant witness of the graviton commutator
briefs.text: We identify the phase of a Bargmann invariant of two matter-wave interferometers as a quantum gravity signature that cannot be reproduced by any branchwise-definite classical gravitational field. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Acoustic Schwarzschild-like black hole and analogous Hawking radiation in Einstein-bumblebee gravity
briefs.text: We derive an acoustic Schwarzschild-like black hole and study its analogous Hawking radiation in Einstein-bumblebee theory by using Gross-Pitaevskii theory in the background of Schwarzschild-like spacetime. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: How to get an attractive model
briefs.text: We give a fourth-order Calabi-Yau differential operator, which seems to have been missed by earlier tabulations.

briefs.headline: All-plus Yang--Mills and gravity wavefunctions in de Sitter space
briefs.text: We present sewing representations for tree-level all-plus wavefunctions in four-dimensional de Sitter space.

briefs.headline: Berends-Giele currents for higher derivative gauge theories
briefs.text: We derive Berends-Giele (BG) currents for higher derivative scalar QED (HDQED) and Yang-Mills (HDYM).

briefs.headline: Two-node Dualities from Elementary Dualities in 3d and 4d
briefs.text: A new 3d $\mathcal{N}=2$ two-node Seiberg-like duality, analogous to the 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Intriligator--Leigh--Strassler~(ILS) duality, is proposed.

briefs.headline: Nonlinear Higher-Spin Theory in $O(4,1)$ de Sitter Space
briefs.text: Four versions of the higher-spin gauge theory compatible with $O(4,1)$ de Sitter geometry in presence of fermions are proposed.
briefs.authors: O. A. Gelfond and M. A. Vasiliev
